results.content:
If Democrats only held around a 2.5-point edge on the generic ballot, the forecast would view the battle for House control to be just about a pure toss-up, with Republicans as heavier favorites to keep the Senate. But now that the Democrats’ edge is 6 points, that puts the party closer to the 7.5-point advantage associated with the Senate being a pure toss-up. In that scenario, the House is much more likely to flip to the Democrats.
